rule dac_gh_0020 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "GitHub: Org Actions permissions set to all repositories or write GITHUB_TOKEN - org actions permissions / default workflow permissions write"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-GH-0020"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1677"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GITHUB"
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "org.update_actions_secret" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "business.update_default_repository_permission" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "org.update_default_repository_permission" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "actions_permissions.policy_updated" nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
